fields.panel1_dialog: Our backup system kept The Challenge ready for November 22!
fields.panel2_dialog: ...it didn't erase several hundred days of edits, right?

narrative_summary: TV4's confident November 22 premiere collapses into a late-spring-2027 re-edit after the backup failure erased the season.
rationale: Candidate 3 uses the Anakin/Padme format exactly as intended: confident premiere, anxious confirmation, then the absurdly distant late-spring-2027 date. It also names the show, premiere date, backup failure, and several hundred erased days without overclaiming that the AI made a guarantee.
story_title: TV4 postpones show after AI agent erases edited material
place: at a pop-up ad that won't close
